topics.title: Java Fundamentals, Memory Model & JVM Internals
topics.description: JDK vs JRE vs JVM, ClassLoader, Stack vs Heap memory, garbage collection algorithms, records, pattern matching, sealed types.

topics.title: Advanced Object-Oriented Programming & SOLID
topics.description: Polymorphism, abstraction, encapsulation, inheritance, SOLID design principles, and enterprise design patterns.

topics.title: Java Collections Framework Internals
topics.description: ArrayList, LinkedList, HashMap hashing & collision resolution, ConcurrentHashMap, TreeMap, PriorityQueue, and Generics.

topics.title: Java Concurrency & Multithreading
topics.description: Thread lifecycles, synchronization, volatile, atomic classes, ReentrantLock, CountDownLatch, ExecutorService, and thread safety.

topics.title: Project Loom & Virtual Threads
topics.description: Platform threads vs Virtual Threads, carrier thread scheduling, continuation yielding, structured concurrency, and scoping.

topics.title: Functional Programming in Java
topics.description: Lambdas, method references, Function, Predicate, Consumer, Supplier, and custom functional interfaces.

topics.title: Java Stream API & Parallel Streams
topics.description: Intermediate vs terminal operations, Collectors, map/filter/reduce, flatMap, performance pitfalls, and parallel streams.

topics.title: Modern File Handling & NIO.2
topics.description: java.nio.file APIs, Path, Files, Channels, ByteBuffers, asynchronous file I/O, and memory-mapped files.

topics.title: RabbitMQ Message Broker & AMQP

topics.title: Apache Kafka Distributed Event Streaming
